summary: Hennessy Advisors filed an 8-K announcing full redemption of its 4.875% Notes due 2026 (HNNAZ). The aggregate principal is $40.25 million; redemption date is June 30, 2026, at 100% of principal plus accrued interest. The redemption eliminates all outstanding notes, triggering a delisting from Nasdaq. This is an issuer capital return via debt repayment, not a tender offer since terms are mandatory. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for the actual redemption payment on June 30; risk-arb is minimal as redemption price is fixed at par.
